name: Product
tagline: A playful, mobile-first design system built on purple gradients, mint-green CTAs, and 3D depth.
description: Extracted from 5 mobile app UI references (language learning, bus tickets, file manager, education, AI chat). Every screenshot shares the same DNA: purple as the dominant accent, soft lavender backgrounds, generous rounded corners, 3D-rendered icons, and mint-green secondary buttons for primary actions.

logo.notes: No logo supplied. Screenshots show app-specific logos only.

colors.name: Lavender Background
colors.usage: Page canvas and app background. Soft lavender wash visible in every screenshot — not plain white.

colors.name: Dark Ink
colors.usage: Body text and headings on light surfaces. Deep purple-black, not pure black.

colors.name: Purple
colors.usage: Primary brand color. Used for headers, card backgrounds, active tabs, progress bars, gradient overlays, and hero sections. Can be used as a large wash — this brand is purple-forward.

colors.name: Mint Green
colors.usage: CTA buttons ('Start Now', 'Generate New', 'Create', 'Search'), progress indicators, and success states. High contrast against purple.

colors.name: White Surface
colors.usage: Card interiors, input fields, modal panels — always white inside the cards, contrasting the lavender page background.

colors.name: Muted Purple
colors.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps. Desaturated purple, not neutral grey.

colors.name: Lavender Border
colors.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Tinted purple to match the overall palette.

voice.tone: Warm, upbeat greeting style ('Hello Alan', 'Hi Julia!', 'Hello, Harry'). Personal, encouraging. Short sentences with exclamation points. Celebrate progress visually with progress bars and completion percentages.
messagingPillars: Personal greeting — every screen opens with the user's name and a warm hello.
Progress visibility — show completion %, loaded files, lesson counts. Users see momentum.
Action-first CTAs — 'Start Now', 'Continue French!', 'Generate New', 'Explore'. Always imperative.

imagery.style: 3D-rendered illustrations with soft lighting and purple/pink tonal gradients. Objects float with drop shadows. Depth and dimensionality over flat icons.
subjects: Friendly round avatar characters with big eyes
Category icons as 3D objects on gradient pedestals
Floating blob shapes as background atmosphere
imagery.treatment: Purple-to-pink gradients on hero sections and card headers. Glassmorphism on overlapping card layers. Soft shadows under every elevated element. Rounded, bubbly forms.

postureRules: Component kit should cover: Button, Card, Form, Navigation, Badge, Input, Modal, Tab bar, Progress bar, Avatar.
Touch targets minimum 44px on mobile surfaces.
Cards have white surface interior on lavender background — the contrast IS the elevation; shadow optional.
Primary CTAs use mint-green fill with dark text; secondary actions use purple fill with white text.
Purple gradients are allowed and expected on card headers, hero sections, and navigation bars — this is not a 'sparingly' accent brand.
Corner radius 16px for cards and buttons; 24px for full-width hero sections; pill shape (999px) for small badges and tags.
3D illustration icons sit on cards, never flat SVG.
